title: Capitalism and Free Markets
description: Voluntary exchange and private property rights lead to optimal outcomes through market forces

coreArchitecture.centralConcept: Voluntary exchange and private property rights lead to optimal outcomes through market forces
coreArchitecture.keyNarratives: Rags-to-riches stories, invisible hand metaphor, creative destruction driving progress
coreArchitecture.invariantElements: Property rights, price signals, individual economic freedom
coreArchitecture.example: The iPhone story - individual profit motive leading to revolutionary innovation benefiting society

transmissionMechanisms.primaryVectors: Economic education, business media, personal experience with markets
transmissionMechanisms.requiredResources: Basic economic literacy, examples of market success
transmissionMechanisms.easeOfTransmission: Complex in theory but reinforced by daily market interactions
transmissionMechanisms.example: Children learning through simple activities like lemonade stands or trading cards

selectionDefense.environmentalFactors: Thrives in periods of technological innovation and visible prosperity
selectionDefense.defenseMechanisms: Attributes failures to government intervention ("not real capitalism")
selectionDefense.competitiveAdvantages: Aligns with observable patterns of innovation and wealth creation
selectionDefense.example: Soviet Union's collapse serving as powerful narrative against alternative systems

evolutionPattern.commonMutations: From mercantilism to industrial to digital/platform capitalism
evolutionPattern.adaptationCapabilities: Absorbing critiques through market-based solutions (e.g., intellectual property markets, prediction markets)
evolutionPattern.stabilityVolatility: Core market mechanism persists while forms of capital/exchange evolve
evolutionPattern.example: Evolution from physical markets to stock markets to cryptocurrency, each maintaining price discovery while expanding what can be traded

socialNetworkEffects.feedbackLoops: Success in capitalism increases belief in the system
socialNetworkEffects.groupIdentity: Entrepreneur/investor culture, markets as moral framework
socialNetworkEffects.statusDynamics: Wealth and business success as social proof of merit
socialNetworkEffects.example: Silicon Valley culture where startup success confers both wealth and moral authority

emotionalHooks.primaryEmotions: Hope for personal success, pride in self-reliance, fear of alternatives
emotionalHooks.rewardMechanisms: Material success, sense of earned achievement
emotionalHooks.motivationStructures: Personal enrichment aligned with social good
emotionalHooks.example: Entrepreneur narratives combining personal gain with changing the world for better
